declarations.name: exists_forwardCoeff_critical_energy_le
declarations.doc: Full positivity bounds the critical weighted square energy of the literal forward coefficients by a single logarithm.

declarations.name: ccmWeilOddPrimeEntrySlope_eq_criticalMellinWallEnergy
declarations.doc: Exact odd entry impulse in critical-Mellin wall-energy normalization.

declarations.name: criticalMellinAtomWeight_primePower_eq_wallFieldEnergy
declarations.doc: At a canonical prime power, critical-Mellin energy is literal zero-height Suzuki wall energy.

declarations.name: riemannHypothesis_iff_fixedCriticalFiber_deflatedSourceEnergy_nonnegative
declarations.doc: Critical-fiber zero-deflated passivity is exactly RH.

declarations.name: exists_hardyCriticalFiber_deflatedSourceEnergy_criterion
declarations.doc: Hardy supplies an unconditional critical fiber whose zero-deflated source passivity is equivalent to RH.

declarations.name: ccmPrimeDeficitCriticalEnergy_integral_le_weilLag_sq
declarations.doc: An unconditional comparison for the full signed deficit, with a fixed allowance for the initial state and the archimedean correction.

declarations.name: summable_reciprocal_square_weight
declarations.doc: Full positivity alone gives finite reciprocal coefficient energy at every real part strictly greater than one half.

declarations.name: reciprocal_dirichletConvergesAt
declarations.doc: The ordinary reciprocal series converges everywhere in the full critical half-plane. Its convergence requires no separate coefficient hypothesis.

declarations.name: deficitInverseWeight_of_offLine
declarations.doc: An off-critical-line copy pays the full reciprocal energy `1/4`.

declarations.name: exists_reciprocal_mean_square
declarations.doc: For every fixed line right of one half, the actual literal reciprocal has mean square equal to its finite coefficient energy. Full positivity is the only arithmetic assumption.

declarations.name: offLine_card_le_four_mul_deficitInverseEnergy
declarations.doc: The reciprocal energy counts every off-line copy, without losing multiplicity.

declarations.name: xiPhysicalThetaAbelEnergyTwoEdgeRemainderBound
declarations.doc: Uniform reciprocal-square remainder constant for the physical-energy two-edge detector.

declarations.name: exists_normalized_critical_null_below
declarations.doc: The signed energy is unbounded below even after fixing the mass to one.

declarations.name: xiWeilSchwarzPairedFiber_evenEnergy_eq_oddEnergy
declarations.doc: Isotropy is exact equality of critical-line reflection parity energies.

declarations.name: eventually_gibbsEnergy_ge
declarations.doc: The critical Gibbs energy is at least `(1/2 − ε) (log N)²` for large `N`.

declarations.name: sum_vonMangoldt_pairs_eq_gibbsEnergy
declarations.doc: `Σ_{n ≥ 2, m ≥ 1, nm ≤ N} Λ(n)/(nm)` is the critical Gibbs energy.

declarations.name: ccmWeilEvenWallEnergyResponse_neg_after_entry
declarations.doc: An even critical-wall response is strictly negative after its own entry.

declarations.name: normSq_suzukiCriticalWallField_zero
declarations.doc: Zero-height wall-field energy is the square of the bare amplitude.

declarations.name: ccmWeilEvenWallEnergyResponse_nonpos_after_entry
declarations.doc: An even critical-wall response is nonpositive at and after its own entry.

declarations.name: twoMode_twoChannelKernel_realRay_energy_nonneg
declarations.doc: Every complex two-mode critical-kernel energy on two ordered exterior Euler-ray nodes is nonnegative. Strict diagonal positivity and the strict complete-divisor determinant give an explicit two-square completion.

exploration.name: sinhTest_energy_ge
exploration.doc: `∫ s(u) sinh(δu) ≥ w (wa)^{5/2} sinh(δ(a - 2w))²` for `0 < w ≤ a/4`.

exploration.name: sinhTest_energy_ge_exp
exploration.doc: The edge energy `P = ∫ s(u) sinh(δu) ≥ b² e^{2δ(b-2)}/16` once `b ≥ 4` and `δ(b - 2) ≥ ½`.
